name: CIE Automotive India Limited
summary: CIE Automotive India Limited, founded in 1999 and based in Mumbai, makes and supplies auto components to OEMs and other customers in India and Europe. Products include forged parts like crankshafts and steering components, stamped body and chassis systems, gears, shafts and axle, transmission and engine parts, as well as magnetic products, molding compounds and aluminum castings.
